### Not a Spirit of Fear
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-august-21-2026.html
Passage: 2 Timothy 1:7
Points:
- Natural fears serve as protective instincts, unlike an ongoing spirit of fear.
- A lingering spirit of fear does not originate from God.
- Believers receive the Holy Spirit, who supplies genuine spiritual power and love.
- Christians should identify areas of fear and pray to walk in divine power and sound thinking.

### Saving Faith
Author: Harry Reeder
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/saving
Passage: 2 Timothy 1:12
Points:
- Facing execution, Paul endured suffering without regret because of his faith in Christ.
- True saving faith is personal and based on rational knowledge of the gospel.
- Biblical faith engages deep conviction and a willing choice to entrust oneself to the Lord.
- Christian assurance points directly to the person of Christ, who is able to guard what is committed to Him.
